summary: Allow the issuing Unix person to revoke retained legacy devices without admitting their credentials

replay.detail: Revoked legacy devices appear in device history. Unrevoked unadmitted legacy devices remain hidden.

schema.detail: No storage schema changes. Revocations use existing native operation authorization receipts.

rules.detail: An issuing person can withdraw an exact retained completion on its issuing member without an admission receipt or migration allowance. The withdrawal does not authorize the legacy bearer or create an allowance. Existing startup rules reject allowances for revoked completions.

compatibility.detail: devices revoke accepts legacy device IDs instead of returning not-found. Other people, agents and non-Unix sessions cannot revoke them. Already revoked devices return a clear error.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.
